newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Q1 industrial production down 6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Q1 industrial production down 6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Ukraine's industrial production in the first quarter of this year was about six percent lower than in the same period last year, a Finance Ministry offficial said on Wednesday.
"The reason for the significant drop in the first quarter figure was a collapse in January production," said Yevhen Frolov, chief of the economic analysis department, at a news conference.
He added industrial production in March was 3.3 percent lower than a year earlier.
He said March output was 14.2 percent higher than the previous month, mainly because of strength in the energy and chemical sectors, and February production was 8.1 percent higher than in January.

The Statistics Ministry, due to release official industrial production figures soon, has said industrial production in February was 6.5 percent lower than a year earlier while output in January was 7.5 percent down.
